verdict.rationale: Netlify's first-party docs describe a public REST API for managing sites, deploys, DNS and more programmatically, which covers driving the product through a documented API. The official CLI and an llms.txt index add AI-friendly access paths. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and deeper evidence of endpoint breadth beyond the one-line docs summary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API—ideal for automating workflows and integrating into your systems.
